description: This Java source file defines the ContactManager class, which manages contact synchronization operations including adding, updating, deleting contacts, managing visibility, and handling sync states within an Android application.

classes.name: ContactManager
classes.description: Main class providing static methods for managing contact synchronization, including creating, updating, deleting contacts and managing sync state flags within the Android contacts provider.

classes.name: ContactManager.EditorQuery
classes.description: Contains projection and column index constants for querying editable contact data rows.

classes.name: ContactManager.ProfileQuery
classes.description: Contains projection and selection constants for querying profile-related contact data.

classes.name: ContactManager.UserIdQuery
classes.description: Contains projection, selection, and URI for querying raw contact IDs based on server contact IDs for sample sync adapter contacts.

classes.name: ContactManager.DirtyQuery
classes.description: Contains constants for querying contacts marked as dirty or deleted needing synchronization.

classes.name: ContactManager.DataQuery
classes.description: Contains constants for querying contact data rows associated with a raw contact ID.

classes.name: ContactManager.ContactQuery
classes.description: Contains projection constants for querying basic contact information such as ID and display name.

methods.name: ensureSampleGroupExists
methods.description: Ensures that a sample group exists in the contacts provider for the given account, creating it if necessary, and returns its ID.

methods.name: updateContacts
methods.description: Processes a list of raw contacts to add, update, or delete them in the contacts provider based on server sync state, batching operations for efficiency.

methods.name: getDirtyContacts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of contacts marked as dirty or deleted from the local contacts database that need to be synchronized.

methods.name: updateStatusMessages
methods.description: Updates status messages for a list of raw contacts in the contact provider, typically used after adding new contacts.

methods.name: clearSyncFlags
methods.description: Clears the dirty and deleted flags on contacts after successful synchronization, deleting contacts marked for deletion.

methods.name: addContact
methods.description: Adds a new contact to the contacts provider with specified details, including group membership and avatar.

methods.name: updateContact
methods.description: Updates an existing contact's data rows with new information, adding missing data where necessary, and optionally updating server IDs and profile data.

methods.name: setAccountContactsVisibility
methods.description: Sets the visibility of contacts for a specific account, making them visible or hidden.

methods.name: getRawContact
methods.description: Retrieves detailed RawContact information from the contacts provider for a given raw contact ID.

methods.name: updateContactStatus
methods.description: Updates a contact's status message, inserting it into the status update stream if a profile exists.

methods.name: clearDirtyFlag
methods.description: Clears the 'dirty' flag on a specified contact to mark it as synchronized.

methods.name: deleteContact
methods.description: Deletes a contact from the contacts provider given its raw contact ID.

methods.name: lookupRawContact
methods.description: Finds the raw contact ID for a given server contact ID; returns 0 if not found.

methods.name: lookupProfile
methods.description: Finds the profile data row ID associated with a server contact ID.
